events.label: June NFP 8:30 AM ET — consensus 100–115K (ADP: 98K miss vs. 110K); TSLA Q2 deliveries (consensus 406K)
events.note: June employment report. Consensus now 100–115K (revised lower from 170K on ADP 98K miss). ADP June: 98,000 (vs. 110K estimate; May: 122K; annual pay +4.4%). Unemployment rate expected 4.3%. THREE SCENARIOS: (1) GOLDILOCKS (80–120K, wages +0.2–0.3%) = BUY activates July 7; DXY breaks <100; NVDA full re-entry; SPCX passive +$4.3B tailwind. (2) WEAK (<80K) = growth scare; TLT long pays; BUY delayed to CPI resolution July 14. (3) HOT (>150K, wages +0.4%) = BofA 3-hike path (Sep/Oct/Dec 2026) locked in through 3-day unhedgeable July 4 gap; SPX gaps lower July 7; HOLD degrades. Markets closed July 3 — NFP reaction plays into a 3-day weekend gap. TSLA Q2 deliveries due same morning: consensus 406,024 vehicles (+12% vs. Q1); beat = constructive; miss + hot NFP = double negative July 7 open.

events.label: US Market Holiday — Independence Day observed (July 4 falls on Saturday)
events.note: US equity markets closed Friday July 3. 3-day weekend gap (July 3–6). June NFP prints Thursday July 2 — any repricing accumulates over the full gap before July 7 open. QQQ puts or TLT held through July 2 are the only active hedges during the gap.

events.label: SPCX added to Nasdaq-100 (~$4.3B forced passive inflows from QQQ/QQQM); post-NFP holiday return
events.note: Dual catalyst day: (1) SPCX Nasdaq-100 inclusion effective July 7 — QQQ/QQQM forced to buy ~$4.3B of SPCX at index weight; mechanical passive-flow catalyst. (2) July 7 open reflects full NFP repricing over the 3-day July 4 gap. Goldilocks NFP: opens constructively; VIX Day 2 sub-17 confirmation = formal BUY with medium conviction; NVDA full re-entry; begin Q2 earnings positioning (GOOGL, META, MSFT, AMZN mid-to-late July). Hot NFP: gap-down into earnings season with compressed multiples. SPX must hold 7,460 and VIX must stay below 17 on July 7 for dual-gate Day 2 confirmation.

events.label: FOMC Minutes from June 17 meeting (est.) — first post-dot-plot-removal release; SK Hynix ADR listing context
events.note: Minutes from the June 17 FOMC meeting (est. release ~3 weeks after meeting). First FOMC at which Warsh removed the dot plot. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — minutes reveal the internal rate debate with full institutional certainty restored. ISM June 53.3 + Prices Paid 73.0 (disinflation) and ADP 98K provide the June data context the June 17 committee did not have. Hawkish tone = BofA 3-hike forecast solidified; any dovish dissent = summer rate-cut optionality opens. SK Hynix ADR listing (first US capital-markets clearing of HBM4 demand thesis) expected around this date — positive read-through for TSM, AVGO, NVDA.

events.label: SK Hynix ADR Nasdaq listing — $29.4B offering, 17.79M shares
events.note: SK Hynix Nasdaq ADR listing — $29.4B offering (17.79M shares). Underwriters: BofA, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, JPMorgan. ISM 53.3 (July 1) confirms the manufacturing/AI capex cycle underpinning HBM4 demand — constructive for ADR pricing. TSM and NVDA read-through is constructive if ADR prices above consensus. HBM4 demand thesis: NVDA H200/B100 requires SK Hynix as primary supplier; ADR is the first US capital-markets clearing of that thesis. Underwriter stabilization mandate provides ADR floor support.

events.label: June CPI release (est.) — most important inflation data of the summer
events.note: June CPI is the next major inflation recalibration after the July 2 NFP. ISM Prices Paid fell sharply to 73.0 from 82.1 in May (July 1 data) — the most significant manufacturing disinflation read since Q1. WTI -30% in Q2 (largest quarterly decline since 2020) captures the first full month of Iran peace normalization. If CPI falls to 3.5% or below: BofA 3-hike framework weakens materially, July 28 FOMC hike probability collapses, BUY conviction upgrades to HIGH for earnings season. If CPI holds at 4.0%+: September hike locked in, multiple compression risk resumes. CPI is the regime-defining data event of the summer.

events.label: TSLA Q2 2026 earnings (est.) — after market close
events.note: Q2 earnings follow the July 2 delivery report (consensus 406,024 vehicles). Management commentary on gross margin, Robotaxi timeline, and FSD revenue will determine whether the Q2 delivery beat translates to an earnings catalyst. Musk 'trillionaire restoration' from June 29 (SpaceX/TSLA) in context; delivery beat needed to sustain above $420 heading into earnings.

events.label: FOMC meeting (July 28-29) — rate hike on the table; BofA calls 3 hikes (Sep/Oct/Dec)
events.note: Nine of 18 FOMC officials projected at least one 2026 rate hike at the June 17 meeting (Warsh's first as Chair). BofA calls for three hikes (Sep/Oct/Dec). ISM June 53.3 with Prices Paid 73.0 (down from 82.1) and WTI at $68 (-30% Q2) give the committee mixed signals — expansion but with material disinflation. June CPI (~July 14) is the primary input: below 3.5% = hike probability collapses; 4.0%+ = September hike effectively locked in. SCOTUS upheld Fed independence June 29 — Warsh can move without political pressure.

events.label: META Q2 2026 earnings — AI cloud business first confirmation; Q2 earnings season peak week
events.note: Bloomberg reported July 1 that Meta is building an AI cloud business to sell excess compute capacity to developers (hosted models and/or raw compute, similar to CoreWeave). META surged +8.88% on the report. Q2 earnings July 29 is the first event where management must quantify the cloud business timeline, potential revenue, and go-to-market plan — the market is pricing substantial optionality ahead of this date. GOOGL, MSFT, and AMZN also report in mid-to-late July. Peak Q3 earnings risk window — positions should be established heading into the first week of July (post-NFP July 7) to capture the pre-earnings buildup. META AI cloud announcement is the single most important new narrative catalyst of July 2026.

events.label: Iran-US Islamabad Declaration 60-day deadline — Hormuz full reopening + sanctions relief
events.note: Deal operational from June 18 MOU signing; 60-day window expires August 13. Iranian exports have already surged past 40 million barrels (July 1 data) as the stand-down takes hold. WTI fell to $68.06 on July 1 (-30% Q2, largest quarterly decline since 2020) — oil normalization is proceeding ahead of the original MOU schedule. If August 13 deadline met with full Hormuz clearance and confirmed sanctions relief, WTI could extend to $62–65. Failure or reversal = oil spike reversal and energy re-rally; Brent trigger returns to focus ($97 threshold). Current Brent ~$70.50 = $26+ buffer; the risk is asymmetric to the downside for oil prices.

events.label: NVDA Q2 FY27 earnings (est.) — $91B revenue guide; AI capex cycle fundamental clearing event
events.note: NVDA's Q2 FY27 earnings is the fundamental clearing event for the AI capex thesis. $91B revenue guidance represents sequential acceleration; any deceleration in the guide would challenge the entire 2026 AI-infrastructure re-rating. NVDA re-entry (half-size July 1 conditional; full size July 7 if Goldilocks NFP) is explicitly positioned around this date as the ultimate confirmation catalyst. TSM, AMD, AVGO all read-through from the NVDA earnings report.

events.label: SPCX first earnings as a public company (approx.) — Starlink ARR + Starship cadence
events.note: First earnings print since the June 12 IPO. SPCX confirmed in Russell 1000 and Nasdaq-100 (effective July 7). Capital structure: $75B IPO + $60B xAI acquisition + $20B bond offering = $155B in obligations. First earnings (Starlink subscriber/ARR growth, Starship launch cadence, cash burn rate) is the fundamental clearing event for re-entry. Two consecutive closes above $185 on above-average volume required before re-entry from current ~$153 range.

events.label: SPCX 180-day IPO lock-up expiry (approx.) — insider/early-investor float unlock
events.note: ~180 days after the June 12 debut, early investors and insiders can sell, materially expanding the ~4% public float. Lock-up expiries are a known supply overhang for hot IPOs; the $20B bond offering (June 22) already changed the capital structure risk profile — the lock-up expiry adds equity supply overhang on top. Exact date pending the prospectus's stated terms.

events.label: OpenAI IPO — target window shifts to H1 2027 after 2026 delay
events.note: OpenAI delayed its anticipated 2026 IPO to H1 2027 (announced June 26, 2026). SoftBank sold off -13% on the delay. Microsoft and NVIDIA hold strategic stakes. The delay removes a near-term AI sentiment catalyst and adds uncertainty to AI infrastructure spending trajectories. Monitor for filing date announcement as a potential AI sentiment catalyst. Date is approximate placeholder for H1 2027 window.
